name: History and baseline review
steps: Open M8 → inspect CKD/prior AKI/KRT/graft history → compare baseline candidates → select source with rationale or mark unavailable → sign assessment.
safety: No inferred baseline; amendments invalidate dependent results.

name: Review current investigations
steps: Inspect original collection/time/specimen/method/quality → compare eligible distinct specimens → target indicated urine/imaging/immune work-up.
safety: Legacy event time is not specimen time; unsupported analytes remain unavailable.

name: Record urine safely
steps: Use existing source owner → choose interval total/point/cumulative/rate → enter actual interval/volume and collection/patency context → validate → review → save once.
safety: A six-hour total is not an hourly reading; preserve uncertain-save lookup.

name: Assess AKI
steps: Pin population/profile/baseline/specimens/output/weight → evaluate criteria separately → show stage, indeterminate branches and evidence → clinician confirmation.
safety: No stage zero from partial negative criteria; no automatic KRT order.

name: Evaluate cause
steps: Record competing possibilities → link support/opposition → check obstruction/patency and nephrotoxins → specialist-directed tests → reassess.
safety: Urine indices or biomarkers do not independently establish etiology.

name: Review urgent support indications
steps: Inspect clinical concern and actual treatment/response → route named urgent review → document acknowledgement/decision/next review.
safety: Creatinine alone cannot trigger dialysis; urgent care is not delayed by computation failure.

name: Authorize support
steps: Select appropriate modality/profile → indication/goals/consent → access confirmation → signed prescription → separate actual start.
safety: Order, preparation and actual treatment have separate states.

name: Set up CRRT
steps: Check access/lumens/filter/machine/solution/anticoagulation → independent checks → actual connection/start → baseline monitoring and next checks.
safety: No pump control or treatment start through ClinRx.

name: Record delivery
steps: Ingest actual timestamped setting/volume/channel events → validate clock/units/counter resets → split segments → retain original sources.
safety: Missing telemetry remains unknown; do not carry flows forward indefinitely.

name: Handle downtime
steps: Record actual stop/reason → check patient and circuit → coordinate citrate/calcium protocol review → actual restart or discontinuation → union downtime.
safety: Do not count simultaneous alarm/access events twice or infer restart from expected time.

name: Daily delivered treatment
steps: Choose reporting interval/weight → inspect measured versus estimated effluent and coverage → show wall-time/run-time summaries separately → review discrepancy.
safety: No uncorrected label of effluent as measured clearance; net removal separate.

name: Citrate monitoring
steps: Identify formulation/actual rates → inspect systemic/postfilter/total calcium sites/times → eligible ratio plus metabolic context → accountable review.
safety: Ratio alone is not diagnosis; no automatic calcium/citrate stop.

name: Filter/alarm troubleshooting
steps: Show original alarm/pressures → bedside nurse check → documented clinician/device response → new circuit if changed → record blood return/loss.
safety: Maintain native alarm semantics; no silence/control API.

name: Drug review
steps: Trigger on AKI/KRT start/stop/change/downtime → medication-owner review of actual exposure/label/renal method/TDM → sign decision → next review.
safety: M6 antimicrobial logic remains owned by antibiotic module.

name: Electrolytes and nutrition
steps: Review actual labs/products/loss estimates → M17 replacement review and M14 nutrition review → link response and due checks.
safety: No duplicated fluids/calories or inferred solution composition.

name: IHD/SLED session
steps: Approve prescription and access → actual session/interruptions and tolerance → source-specific adequacy sampling → session summary and next plan.
safety: No CRRT mL/kg/h metric substituted for intermittent adequacy.

name: PD exchange
steps: Enable supported PD profile → approve exchange plan → actual fill/dwell/drain/product → record incomplete exchange/complications → review.
safety: Unsupported PD stays record-only, not generic CRRT.

name: Modality transition
steps: Review reason → close actual old segment → document gap → approve new prescription/anticoagulation/access → actual start → medication reassessment.
safety: IHD and CRRT exposure and targets remain separately labelled.

name: Recovery and trial off
steps: Review continuing indications/native evidence → authorize trial → actual stop → monitoring/escalation → continue off/restart with rationale.
safety: Low creatinine on KRT does not prove native recovery.

name: Transfer and follow-up
steps: Reconcile renal state/uncertainties/medications/access/next session → receiving owner acknowledgement → discharge education and individualized follow-up.
safety: No planned follow-up represented as completed.

name: Source correction
steps: Inspect exact owner/history → append reasoned successor of same source → refresh shared catalog → mark dependent drafts/results stale.
safety: Never replace source, create new specimen or rebase a note silently.

name: Uncertain save recovery
steps: Keep editor mounted → retain exact canonical request/digest → lookup exact outcome → resume explicit confirmation or retry only after proven absence.
safety: No blind retries; late result cannot overwrite a different patient/source.

name: Bedside review
steps: Four cards → open original source/history → select next review/rationale/owner/time → pin snapshot → record explicit session or approved durable review.
safety: Current implementation is session-only; durable clinical workflow is future work.
